commits.subject: losus: patch-stack tooling, hooks and CI
commits.purpose: Losus patch-stack tooling: hooks, stack manifest, stack-guard and upstream-rebase workflows (the promote job also creates the GitHub release for the tag it pushes), agent skill

commits.subject: losus: add Roster sidebar hook and @losus-ai/ui pin
commits.purpose: Mount the Losus Roster sidebar section: render LosusAgents from @losus-ai/ui in Sidebar.svelte inside a data-losus="sidebar-losus" wrapper (the rebase verify marker) and pin @losus-ai/ui in package.json and the lockfile. On conflict keep upstream's Sidebar.svelte and re-add only the import and the wrapper.

commits.subject: losus: raise the Node heap for the upstream image build in CI
commits.purpose: CI workaround: enable upstream's commented-out NODE_OPTIONS line at 6144 MB (with a grep guard) before the verify job's docker build, because the default ~4 GB Node heap runs out of memory in the frontend stage. Drop this commit if upstream raises the heap itself; if the guard fails after a rebase, check whether upstream changed that Dockerfile line.

commits.subject: losus: use the @losus-ai scope in the fork-stack skill example
commits.purpose: Documentation only: keep the fork-stack skill's example in step with the published package scope (@losus-ai/ui). Safe to drop or re-apply by hand on conflict; keep it identical to the losus-roster copy.

commits.subject: losus: bump @losus-ai/ui to 0.0.3, add the fork notice, Node 24 actions
commits.purpose: Keep the pinned @losus-ai/ui current (0.0.3: theme tokens and ThemeSettings), record the fork's identity and license position in LOSUS_FORK_NOTICE.md, and move the Losus workflows to Node 24 action versions. No product code; all behavior ships in the npm package.

commits.subject: losus: bump @losus-ai/ui to 0.0.4 and refresh the host chat list when Roster moves a chat
commits.purpose: Keep the pinned @losus-ai/ui current (0.0.4: projects, the agent picker and the left-panel arrangement), and let the package tell the host's sidebar that a chat moved, by one event listener on the existing svelte:window, so the host's chat list refreshes. No product code; all behavior ships in the npm package.

commits.subject: losus: enforce agent-limited projects (server guard and model picker)
commits.purpose: Roster's agent-limited projects. backend/open_webui/utils/losus_guard.py asks Roster's runtime (LOSUS_RUNTIME_URL; off when unset) which agents a top-level folder allows, and one call per site returns 403 agent_not_allowed: main.py chat_completion, chat_completed and chat_action; chats.py /new, /import, /{id}/folder, /{id}/clone and /{id}/fork. ModelSelector.svelte lists only the allowed agents in a locked project and Chat.svelte stops writing the picker's model back into a locked folder. On conflict keep upstream and re-add the one call per site; roster's scripts/check-guard-routes.py lists the routes and fails on a new unguarded one.
